subject: Release memo — f00tils 0.16.8
ref: README drop-in, site #drop-in, F00_CORE wiring, v0.16.7
opening: Bottom line: 0.16.8 clarifies drop-in policy and finishes F00_CORE. Scripts and non-TTY do not auto-enable --core; only chrome is TTY-gated. Documented on README and https://coreutils.f00.sh/#drop-in. F00_CORE=1 / core=true now seeds GNU-clone mode for find, grep, and diffutils as well as ls.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: Record the drop-in clarification and F00_CORE fix under house prime directive.

sections.heading: 2. Behavior truth
items: Modern semantics remain on pipes unless core is set (find skips .git, grep smart-case, …)
GNU clone: --core, F00_CORE=1, or config core=true
Installer replace does not set F00_CORE

sections.heading: 3. Code
items: find/grep/diff/cmp/sdiff/diff3 seed local core flags from g_json_core at entry
Docs: README, site callout, MODERN-FEATURES, install seed comments

steps.text: F00_CORE=1 f00-find … includes .git; without it modern skips .git
F00_CORE=1 f00-grep hello is case-sensitive (no smart-case)

sections.heading: 5. Install
sections.body: curl -fsSL https://coreutils.f00.sh/install.sh | bash  · pin F00_VERSION=v0.16.8 · drop-in: F00_CORE=1
